description: This file defines the EndpointV2Middleware class used within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles endpoint rule evaluation, endpoint resolution, and applies authentication schemes for AWS API commands. It contains methods for wrapping the middleware, resolving arguments for endpoint setup, and binding various context parameters, as well as methods for authenticating and resolving account IDs.

classes.name: EndpointV2Middleware
classes.description: Handles endpoint rule evaluation, endpoint resolution, and authentication scheme application in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that constructs an EndpointV2Middleware instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with handler, endpoint provider, service API, client arguments, and credential provider.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invoked when the middleware handles a command, resolves endpoint, and applies authentication schemes.

methods.name: resolveArgs
methods.description: Resolves various arguments and parameters needed for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: filterEndpointCommandArgs
methods.description: Filters command arguments based on ruleset parameters and service-specific options.

methods.name: bindStaticContextParams
methods.description: Binds static context parameters for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: bindContextParams
methods.description: Binds context parameters from command arguments.

methods.name: bindOperationContextParams
methods.description: Binds operation-specific context parameters utilizing JSON path search.

methods.name: applyAuthScheme
methods.description: Applies the selected authentication scheme to the command.

methods.name: resolveAuthScheme
methods.description: Resolves the first valid authentication scheme supported by the client.

methods.name: normalizeAuthScheme
methods.description: Normalizes an auth scheme's details into SDK-understandable format.

methods.name: isValidAuthScheme
methods.description: Checks if an auth scheme name is valid and supported.

methods.name: resolveAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID from credentials when necessary.
